relations.subject: Charles Wilkins
relations.evidence: Sir Charles Wilkins (1749 – 13 May 1836) was an English typographer and scholar who co-founded The Asiatic Society.

relations.subject: Charles Wilkins
relations.evidence: In 1784, Wilkins helped William Jones establish the Asiatic Society of Bengal.

relations.subject: Charles Wilkins
relations.evidence: Wilkins moved to Benares (Varanasi), where he studied Sanskrit under Kalinatha, a Brahmin pandit.

relations.subject: Charles Wilkins
relations.evidence: In 1800, he was invited to take up the post of the first director of the India House Library

relations.subject: Charles Wilkins
relations.evidence: In 1801 he became librarian to the East India Company

relations.subject: Charles Wilkins
relations.evidence: He was named examiner at Haileybury when a college was established there in 1805.
